title: WCS page footer: follow-up of #1209

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

body:
PR #1209 merged as b48c65828 and closed #870. The PR-reviewer found no blockers. It listed the non-blocking findings below (review comment 6976698898). This issue tracks them.

## Checklist

- [ ] "Set origin" (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_footer.rs:51`) is always enabled. A click with no pending edit queues a `SetWcs` that changes nothing. It adds an empty undo step. Enable the button only while edits are pending. Add a test of the enabled state.
- [ ] The text "(X0 Y0 Z0)" is coordinate notation in user-facing text (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_footer.rs:24`, `crates/app/src/setup_sheet/sections.rs:130`). It breaks the plain-English rule for UI text. Use plain words, such as "the program's zero point".
- [ ] The footer row does not wrap in a narrow pane. It uses `ui.horizontal` (`wcs_footer.rs:50-57`). The "Origin not applied" label can be cut at the right edge. Check whether `horizontal_wrapped` fixes it.
- [ ] The setup sheet writes origin distances in mm only (`crates/app/src/setup_sheet/sections.rs:129`). It ignores the document units. See #902.
- [ ] On rotated or aligned setups, "left" and "front" name world directions, not setup directions. Decide the wording for these setups. The origin words use the world-frame box (see #326).
- [ ] `crates/ui/src/egui_app/pages.rs` is over the 400-line limit. It had 682 lines on main before PR #1209. Split it along the domain seam.

## Done means

Each checklist item is fixed with a test that pins the fix, or is closed with a reason in a comment.
